DYS-012 · M4 — Preview, compositing, and mobile editing

Responsive mobile editing

In progress · viewport acceptance remains

Implemented interaction foundation

  • Persistent bottom navigation, preview-first layout and independent horizontal timeline scrolling.
  • Long-press movement on Master and nested timelines, contextual clip tools, Inspector toggle and Zoom In / Zoom Out / Fit.
  • Touch trim affordances, pointer-captured frame-aligned scrubbing, frame stepping/counter, keyboard frame stepping and mobile version picker.
  • Preview Undo/Redo; selected-audio Mute/Unmute with visible pressed state.
  • PR #84 compact Master Timeline layer action menu with touch-sized controls and reduced toolbar density.
  • PR #86 progressive disclosure: primary preview actions stay visible while +0.5s, the playhead slider, Overlay and optional image clear are grouped under More controls on phone-width screens.

Release verification

PR #86 merged as app commit 6e130e33a4236fff97f468f6d76fef933677bb58. Exact-head feature CI, main push CI and GitHub Pages deployment passed.

No automated browser smoke tests were added or run. CI/deployment are not evidence of real-device acceptance.

Acceptance still required

  • No page-level horizontal overflow on phone portrait, phone landscape and tablet sizes.
  • Layer actions remain reachable above bottom navigation and safe-area insets.
  • Touch selection, scrubbing, moving, trimming, version switching, Undo/Redo and audio mute work reliably.
  • Storyboard, Timeline, Assets and References remain reachable.
  • Record owner viewport acceptance after deployed build is confirmed.
